guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (reset active), done_state_q is asynchronously forced to the constant DoneAwaitCmd.
On every positive edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high, done_state_q takes the value of done_state_d after the clock edge.

assumptions.claim: done_state_d must represent a legal encoding of the done-state machine at every clock edge to avoid deadlock or unintended operation.
assumptions.cond: always at posedge clk_i with rst_ni high
assumptions.risk: An invalid state stored in done_state_q may cause downstream logic to hang or mis-handle completion signaling, potentially affecting HMAC operation.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be cleanly asserted and deasserted meeting removal/recovery timing with respect to clk_i to avoid metastability on done_state_q.
assumptions.risk: A glitch or timing violation could cause done_state_q to take a transient incorrect value, disrupting the done handshake sequence.

uncertain_points.claim: done_state_d is computed outside this chunk; the correctness of the entire done handshake depends on that logic properly advancing the state based on inputs and current done_state_q.
uncertain_points.cond: whenever done_state_d changes, external logic must ensure the next state is legal
uncertain_points.risk: If the external next-state logic produces an illegal or stuck state, HMAC command completion signalling may fail, potentially leading to protocol deadlock or false completion.
